title: Create a governed RFx draft
intro: Choose the request type that best fits the market conversation you need to begin. Your organization owns every draft created here.
privateDraftDetail: Drafts are not published, visible on the map, discoverable, matched, or sent to responders.
permissionBody: Your current organization role does not permit RFx creation. No draft information has been disclosed.
nextBoundary: Need, scope, location, value, requirements, readiness, and publication become available only in later governed steps.
createBody: This first action creates only the private RFx kernel and its governed request-type snapshot.
changed: Request type updated with a new draft version.
recovered: The previously completed RFx change was recovered without duplication.
error: The RFx action could not be completed.
packageSaved: RFx package saved with a new draft version.
packageBoundary: Saving updates this private draft only. It does not publish or create market activity.
needHelp: Describe the business condition and target outcome before prescribing a solution.
sourceStatement: What do you need the market to help with?
interpretBoundary: Optional suggestions only; your review and a separate save are required.
interpretNeedsSource: Enter a source statement before requesting suggestions.
interpretUnavailable: Suggestions are unavailable. Continue with the manual builder.
interpretRecorded: Your review was recorded. No RFx field changed automatically.
locationUnavailable: Confirm an organization location before adding a performance location.
locationBoundary: Operational location stays private in this draft; publication visibility is a separate governed decision.
requirementsBoundary: Add only foundation requirements here. Capability qualifiers, response sections, evaluation factors, and readiness come later.
definitionIntro: Define what organizations must demonstrate, how they respond, and how the issuer will compare confirmed information.
definitionSaveError: The RFx definition could not be saved. Review the fields and try again.
requiredCapabilitiesHelp: Use governed capabilities and requirement types. Potential fit never means qualification or endorsement.
customSectionHelp: Add an RFx-specific responder section without changing the governed catalog.
customFactorHelp: Add an RFx-specific factor. This defines future evaluation; it does not score a response.
readinessIntro: The server checks the current RFx, geography, authority, and responder projection before publication.
readinessError: Readiness could not be checked. No publication occurred.
publishError: The RFx was not published. Recheck readiness and try again.
publicationBoundary: Basic issuance is included for eligible organizations. Publication is atomic and cannot be undone in this slice.
publicationLoadError: The committed publication is temporarily unavailable.
shareAuthorityBoundary: This link preserves intent but grants no membership, response, invitation, or qualification authority.
publicBoundaryTitle: The responder-visible RFx, exactly as published.
publicBoundaryBody: Private locations, actors, internal notes, audit evidence, and interpretation records are excluded from this projection.

finding.lifecycle_not_draft: Return to the current draft lifecycle.
finding.amacs_provenance_incomplete: Restore the governed AMACS request-type snapshot.
finding.timing_sequence_invalid: Correct the start and completion sequence.
finding.geography_authority_unavailable: Confirm a currently released performance locality.
finding.authority_publish_unavailable: Your current role cannot publish this RFx.
finding.requirement_response_link_missing: Link this requirement to a response section.
finding.requirement_evaluation_link_missing: Link this requirement to an evaluation factor.
finding.requirement_evidence_link_missing: Link this evidence requirement to governed evidence.

discovery.title: Find real published opportunities
discovery.emptyTitle: No permitted opportunities match this search
discovery.emptyBody: Broaden or clear the filters. The Exchange does not create placeholder opportunities or infer market activity.
discovery.actionError: The change was not confirmed. Retry it from the current opportunity state.

search.label: Opportunity, requirement, issuer, or capability
search.truth: Only real, currently permitted publications are shown.

deadlines.title: Watched deadlines
deadlines.source: Derived from canonical response deadlines and the server clock.

saved.label: Saved search name
saved.confirmed: Search saved with its current governed filters.

watch.confirmed: Opportunity added to your private watch view.
watch.removed: Opportunity removed from your private watch view.

detail.disclaimer: Discovery and watching do not mean qualification, eligibility, endorsement, invitation, pursuit, selection, or award likelihood.

pursuit.title: Assess opportunity fit
pursuit.intro: Compare published facts with your organization’s confirmed capability profile, record judgment, and choose a pursuit state.
pursuit.boundaryTitle: Decision support, not a qualification score.
pursuit.boundaryBody: RFxchange shows exact confirmed AMACS alignments and explicit gaps. Your organization makes and owns the pursuit decision.
pursuit.stale: The opportunity or capability profile changed. Review this current fit before saving.
pursuit.noGaps: No current profile gaps were identified. This does not determine eligibility or award likelihood.
pursuit.responseUnavailable: Response construction and submission are not available in this slice.
pursuit.managementUnavailable: Your organization role can inspect fit but cannot change the pursuit decision.
pursuit.error: The pursuit could not be saved. Refresh to review current facts.
pursuit.teamCoverage: May be satisfied by an accepted response team in a later authorized workflow.

saved.watch: Opportunity is on your organization watch list.
saved.decline: Decline decision recorded for your organization.
